# Portable proof-reader inputs

All inputs here are synthetic and nonsecret. No native journal, private payload
or complete personal packet is copied. Absolute originals are mapped into the
pytest temporary directory before each independently bound plan is created.

- `collection-oracle.json` is an independent normative node/family manifest.
- `collection.txt` is the separate native Module/Function-shaped observation.
- `coverage-recipe.json` is a normative recipe with 37 root labels, based on the
  five CLI, thirty public and two failed-registry root roles in the retained
  caller's source. Its synthetic command recipe expands to 305 commands. The
  seven Git actions per root and 46 supplemental records are **synthetic**;
  this does not certify the retained producer's complete command IDs or argv.

The tests bind expected coverage before constructing observations. Receipt
omission or duplication cannot update that binding. Cache/transport fixture
imports explicitly use the independent `baseline` role and cannot define
normative coverage. Schema anchors were read from the preserved caller helpers
`g_tracked_verifier.py`, `g_phase_command_verifier.py`, `g_cli_verifier.py` and
`g_registry_reference_verifier.py`, plus `session_registry.issue_plan` source.
The reader imports none of those helpers or retained product modules.

C1 must independently enumerate and bind its full command plan from the saved
producer/fixture construction recipe before START. The portable synthetic
controls here do not constitute C1 packet admission or native execution proof.
